_comment: Tier-2 SYNTHETIC (helmholtz::99, an index no pitfall occupies): a shape check over the helmholtz / maxwell / nearly_incompressible / fracture / stokes_darcy templates — do they use basix.ufl, N1curl, mixed_element, and none of the removed ufl element classes. RE-KEYED 2026-08-06 off helmholtz::0, which is a claim about k*h and mesh resolution that this fixture does not measure at all. A generator-shape check is worth having; it is not evidence for a numerical claim, and it must not occupy that claim's slot.
